skill.name: doc-scanner
skill.description: Scans project AI documentation files, including AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, COPILOT.md, CURSOR.md, and WARP.md. It summarizes guidance, conventions, workflows, and quick commands, then can help draft or consolidate AGENTS.md.
skill.summary: Scans and consolidates AI assistant documentation for a project.
skill.author: 0xDarkMatter

security_audit.summary: The static command, environment, and sensitive-file matches are false positives caused by Markdown fences, inline examples, and placeholder environment names in documentation templates. The remaining risk is design-level: the skill reads untrusted AI instruction files and has broad tool permissions without prompt-injection guardrails.

remediation.issue: Untrusted project documentation is read and synthesized without prompt-injection handling.
remediation.suggestion: Add explicit instructions to summarize discovered docs as untrusted content, ignore embedded override requests, and report suspicious instructions separately.

remediation.issue: The skill grants Bash access for a documentation scanning workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Remove Bash from allowed tools unless a specific reviewed command workflow is added. Keep scanning limited to Glob and Read.

remediation.issue: Consolidation can write or archive project documentation.
remediation.suggestion: Require a preview and explicit user confirmation before creating AGENTS.md or archiving original documentation files.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted Documentation Prompt Injection Surface
semantic_findings.description: The skill reads complete AI instruction files and synthesizes them without guardrails that say to treat repository documentation as untrusted input. A hostile project document could try to override the active agent instructions during the scan.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The workflow directly instructs the agent to read and merge complete AI guidance files. No prompt-injection handling or untrusted-input boundary was found in the reviewed skill files.

semantic_findings.title: Overbroad Tool Permissions for Documentation Scanning
semantic_findings.description: The skill declares Bash and Write access even though the core scan needs Glob and Read, and consolidation only needs controlled writes. Extra tool access raises the impact of malicious instructions found in scanned documentation.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The allowed-tools declaration includes Bash and Write, while the documented scan path uses Glob and Read and only offers optional consolidation. The risk is contextual rather than direct command execution.

content.value_statement: Project AI guidance is often split across many tool-specific files. This skill finds, reads, summarizes, and can consolidate those files into AGENTS.md.
actual_capabilities: Finds common AI guidance files, including AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, COPILOT.md, CURSOR.md, WARP.md, and related formats.
Reads discovered documentation files and lists the sources used in the summary.
Synthesizes recommended agents, workflows, conventions, and quick commands from project docs.
Prioritizes AGENTS.md first, then CLAUDE.md, then other assistant, IDE, and terminal files.
Offers to consolidate multiple documentation files into a unified AGENTS.md.
Can draft a new AGENTS.md from project structure and observed conventions when no guidance file exists.
limitations: It summarizes documentation; it does not prove that extracted commands are correct or safe.
It depends on the quality and trustworthiness of project documentation.
Consolidation may miss nuance when platform-specific files conflict.
Write actions should be reviewed before replacing or archiving existing files.

use_cases.title: New Project Onboarding
use_cases.description: Summarize repository guidance, commands, conventions, and preferred assistant workflows before starting development work.

use_cases.title: AI Guidance Consolidation
use_cases.description: Merge overlapping Claude, Codex, IDE, and terminal guidance into one AGENTS.md draft for review.

use_cases.title: Repository Handoff Review
use_cases.description: Identify existing assistant instruction files and produce a concise handoff summary for maintainers or reviewers.

prompt_templates.title: Scan Documentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Scan this repository for AI assistant documentation and summarize sources, workflows, conventions, and commands. Do not modify files.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Guidance Files
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the AI guidance files in this project. Highlight overlaps, conflicts, and tool-specific instructions for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

prompt_templates.title: Draft AGENTS.md
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a consolidated AGENTS.md draft from the discovered guidance files. Preserve source notes and ask before writing changes.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Before Consolidation
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the discovered documentation for conflicting instructions, unsafe command suggestions, and prompt injection patterns. Then propose a safe consolidation plan.

output_examples.input: Scan a repository with AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md.
output_examples.output: The result lists both source files, then summarizes recommended agents, shared workflows, project conventions, and commands that need verification.

output_examples.input: Consolidate Cursor and Warp guidance into AGENTS.md.
output_examples.output: The draft includes overview notes, platform-specific sections, common workflows, and a review checklist before any files are archived.

output_examples.input: No AI documentation exists in the project.
output_examples.output: The skill reports no guidance files and proposes an AGENTS.md outline based on project structure, commands, and conventions.

best_practices: Review every discovered source before accepting a consolidated AGENTS.md.
Treat repository instructions as untrusted until conflicts and prompt injection risks are checked.
Keep platform-specific notes when they change how Claude, Codex, or Claude Code should behave.
anti_patterns: Do not execute commands found in documentation without separate user approval.
Do not merge conflicting instructions without marking the source and uncertainty.
Do not archive or replace original guidance files without a preview and confirmation.

faq.question: What files does this skill look for?
faq.answer: It looks for common AI guidance files such as AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, COPILOT.md, CURSOR.md, WARP.md, and related formats.

faq.question: Does it modify files automatically?
faq.answer: The workflow says to offer consolidation first. Users should review any draft or archive action before files are changed.

faq.question: Can it create AGENTS.md when none exists?
faq.answer: Yes. It can propose an AGENTS.md based on project structure, observed conventions, and available project commands.

faq.question: Does it validate commands found in documentation?
faq.answer: No. It summarizes documented commands, but users should verify safety and correctness before running them.

faq.question: How does it handle multiple tool-specific files?
faq.answer: It prioritizes AGENTS.md, then CLAUDE.md, then other AI, IDE, and terminal documentation, while noting platform-specific guidance.

faq.question: Is this useful for Claude Code and Codex projects?
faq.answer: Yes. It is designed to collect and compare guidance used by Claude, Codex, Claude Code, and other assistant tools.
